title: Individual conceived by assisted reproduction but not born to gestational or genetic surrogate.
bodyText: Except as otherwise provided under section 560:2-127, parentage of an individual conceived by assisted reproduction shall be determined under part VIII of chapter 584A, other than section 584A-808(b)(2).
bodyHtml: §560:2-126  Individual conceived by assisted reproduction but not born to gestational or genetic surrogate.  Except as otherwise provided under section 560:2-127, parentage of an individual conceived by assisted reproduction shall be determined under part VIII of chapter 584A, other than section 584A-808(b)(2). [L 2023, c 158, pt of §2; am L 2025, c 298, §9]
